question: Why isn't the sensor reading?

findings.title: SDA and SCL are swapped
findings.explanation: bme280_1 SDA lands on esp32_1 GPIO22 and SCL on GPIO21. The esp32-devkitc default I2C pins are SDA=GPIO21, SCL=GPIO22, so the bus scan finds no device.
findings.fix: Swap the yellow wire (I18) and the green wire (I15)
